hook_text: Tapped the eye. Finished a hobby.

song.title: Focus Mode
song.style: English, mellow indie folk with banjo, soft brushed drums, warm cello, gentle duet vocals, 96 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Tapped the eye and it went quiet
Phone face down against the wall
Picked the sweater I abandoned
Knitted all the way through fall

[Chorus]
Focus mode, focus mode
Little hands and a long slow road
Focus mode, focus mode
Look at all the things I made

shots.prompt: A woman holds up a finished, wildly long striped scarf that unrolls all the way across the room, beaming with pride. Static wide shot. Warm afternoon light, bright stripes.
A man paints a small canvas of a mountain at an easel by the window, adds a final dab and steps back. Static medium shot. Soft daylight.

A finger gently taps the round pale yellow disc on a small rounded moss-green brick stuck to a white fridge door, a black smartphone standing upright inside it facing the wall. Warm kitchen light slowly shifts across the fridge. Static close-up.
A girl builds a tall wobbly tower of wooden blocks on the floor and it stays standing as she throws her hands up. Static low shot. Warm lamp light.
A boy waters a row of seedlings on a sunny windowsill, each one unfolding a tiny leaf. Close-up, the camera slides along the windowsill. Bright morning light, fresh greens.
A grandmother teaches a child to play a simple tune on a small piano, both swaying. Static medium shot. Warm golden light.
A man fixes a bicycle wheel in a garden shed, spins it and nods happily. Static medium shot. Dusty afternoon sunbeams.
Friends gather around a table admiring a lumpy homemade clay vase, passing it around and cheering. Static medium shot. Warm evening light.
A woman sits in a window seat wrapped in her long striped scarf, sipping tea as the sun sets over the rooftops. The camera slowly pulls back. Peach and gold, calm.

caption: Tapped the eye on my Hibernator, my phone went quiet, and I finally finished the scarf. It is twelve feet long. No regrets.
